text:
I took the plate to be a standard dinner plate of about 26 cm across.

The ribs are two short rib sections, each roughly 20 cm long and 4 cm wide. Each is about 2.5 cm thick, with bone and meat. That puts each rack piece at about 100 g, so about 200 g in total. The glaze is part of the ribs and not listed separately.

The carrots are 4 baby carrot pieces, each about 6 cm long and 1.8 cm wide, and each weighs about 10 g. That comes to about 40 g in total.
